listing.name: Order from the Boss
listing.summary: Allows players to force allied ships to perform simple actions like venting, using ship systems, toggling shields, or firing missiles.
listing.aiSummary: Allows players to force allied ships to perform simple actions like venting, using ship systems, toggling shields, or firing missiles.

description:
A simple mod to solve my problem seeing an ally misses another timing to vent or torpedo enemy. This mod allows you to force allies to do simple things like venting / use shipsystem / toggle shield / fire missile weapons.

To use: Hold R and move mouse over an ally as the target, press Q switch target if many modules overlapping.

Download at github link

https://github.com/a111164i/Order-from-the-Boss/releases/download/0.98a/Order.from.the.Boss.EN.zip

.

aiDescription: This mod solves the problem of allies missing timing opportunities to vent or torpedo enemies. It allows you to hold R and move the mouse over an ally to target them, then press Q to switch targets if modules overlap. You can then force allies to vent, use ship systems, toggle shields, or fire missile weapons.
